_note: The single source of truth for the environment BOTH implementations run under.
tests/golden/capture.py reads this file when recording goldens and copies `pinned`
into goldens/manifest.json; tests-ts/parity.mjs reads it, asserts the manifest still
agrees, and constructs each child's environment from scratch out of `pinned` +
`passthrough` + per-case keys. Nothing else is inherited, so an ambient TZ/LANG on a
developer's shell cannot silently change what 'parity' means.
TZ is load-bearing, not decorative: usage.py:709 renders block labels via
datetime.astimezone() with no argument, so `blocks` output moves with the local zone.
Measured 2026-07-31: TZ=UTC changes blocks_normal and nothing else. The value below is
the zone the goldens were captured under, recorded here instead of inherited.
HOME is pinned to a synthetic, empty fixture home (tests/harness/fixtures.py) so the
harness never globs the developer's real ~/.claude/projects (usage.py:619) or their
real ~/.codex (usage.py:197). Measured 2026-07-31: all 33 goldens are byte-identical
under a synthetic HOME, so this costs no fidelity and buys determinism plus privacy.
